name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.3
body:
## Features / 主要更新

- Raycast- and Linear-style timeline for release history. / 采用 Raycast 与 Linear 风格的时间轴展示发布记录。
- A lightweight in-app update banner collapses to an update bell after a successful upgrade. / 升级完成后在主窗口显示轻量应用内通知，并自动收起为更新铃铛。
- DeepSeek whale branding with adaptive light and dark glass styling. / 使用 DeepSeek 小蓝鲸标识，并适配浅色与深色毛玻璃主题。
- Persistent updater progress and terminal status in the user data directory. / 在用户数据目录持久化记录更新进度和最终状态。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- Atomic rows make features, improvements, and fixes easier to scan. / 采用原子行布局，更清晰地区分新功能、优化和修复。
- Same-window release history drawer with no separate update window or floating HUD. / 更新日志在当前窗口内滑出侧边抽屉，不再创建独立更新窗口或浮动 HUD。
- Graceful handoff waits for the desktop shell before replacing the portable runtime. / 更新前安全交接，升级前安全退出并替换便携运行时。
- Failed or interrupted updates remain visible and can be retried. / 更新失败或中断后保留可见状态，并支持重新检查。
